Async::run(function () use ($options): void {

        ? Connection::connect($options, preparedCacheLimit: 2)->await()
        : Connection::connect($options)->await();

    $statement->execute([1, 0])->await();
    $pending = $statement->execute([2, .2]);
    Async::sleep(.01);
    if ($pending->isCompleted()) throw new RuntimeException('Query was not pending');
    echo json_encode(['pending' => true]), "\n";
    if (getenv('ASYNCARA_CONTROL_MODE') === 'fatal') trigger_error('Intentional matched fatal', E_USER_ERROR);
    exit(0);
});
